algorithm: TF-IDF weighted, row-normalized truncated SVD; unit song factors V sqrt(S); mean seed cosine
identity_policy: Exact recording MBID only. No title matching, redirects or canonical-version merging; coverage is a conservative lower bound for this sample, not all ListenBrainz.
signal: Explicit positive feedback (loves), not play counts. Dislikes are excluded; missing feedback is not a dislike.

evaluation.protocol: One held-out workshop love per listener with >=3 workshop loves; 1-5 seeds; fit after removal; same >=5-training-listener candidate pool; seed exclusion; fixed random split, not temporal.
